name: Kakuriyo no Senkouka -Negau Saki-
original_name: 隠世ノ鮮紅花ー願ウ先ー
source:
An after story continuation of the AVG "Kakuriyo no Senkouka".

Two types of scenarios included:
(1) Each character's good ending after story
(2) A past story that wasn't included in the original work

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE254966.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
AVG《幽世闪耀花》的后日谈续作。

包含两类剧本：
（1）每位角色的好结局后日谈。
（2）原作未收录的过去故事。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE254966.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
